candidates.notes: to exchange, to convert, to replace
to back, to install a leader
to get new, to replace with new
to be absorbed in, to spend days
to write in, to fill in
to begin writing; to list out
way of writing, how to write
stand close together, rise in clusters
to take root, to become established
to worry, to be anxious about
to master, to carry to extremes
to lie down, to stretch across
to walk, to go on foot, to tread
to be immersed, to be soaked
to well up, to spring forth
to get damp, to become moist
to perform, to play a role
to be on the verge of
to flare up, to burst into flames
to be reborn, to be reincarnated
